newsitem.title: USA: Storage Trust buys 15 self-storage centers.
newsitem.headline: Storage Trust buys 15 self-storage centers.

text.p: Storage Trust Realty on Thursday said it acquired 15 self-storage centers in the first quarter of 1997 for a total price of $27.7 million.

The company said all of the centers except one were acquired for cash using the remaining proceeds from its funding of $75 million of unsecured notes and the company's revolving line of credit. Storage Trust assumed and then paid off the existing mortgage of one facility.
Storage Trust is a real estate investment trust with 190 self-storage facilities in 18 states.
